protocol.unit: timed kernel signature ('kind', 'x', 'n_out_local', 'batch_local', 'kernel', 'stride', 'padding', 'bias'); n_out_full excluded (does not enter the timed kernels), kept as per-use metadata; device, float32 and TF32-off are constant and asserted
protocol.records: measured rows of layer_timings_summary.csv, last row per shape_id (ingestion rule)
protocol.record_time: sum of forward, input-gradient and weight-gradient median times
protocol.signature_time: median over the signature's records of the record time
protocol.split: signatures sorted by typed value, shuffled with random.Random(seed), first floor(n/2) calibration
protocol.estimator: R = sum(3F)/sum(T) over calibration signatures; prediction 3F/R
protocol.variability: seeds 0-99, median and 5th-95th percentiles over seeds
protocol.ranking: within (workload, layer), pairs of measured configurations with the nominal planner's per-configuration time and FLOPs (raw-input gradient omitted for layers consuming the graph input); split-independent
protocol.scaling: T(p0) p0 / (T(p) p), p0 = smallest measured DP count of the layer, planner times as for ranking

scaling_efficiency.reference: smallest measured DP count p0 of each layer

repeatability.statistic: IQR/median of the repetitions of one record and product, then median and 90th percentile over measured records
repeatability.scope: repetitions within one session on one GPU (30 after 10 warm-up iterations); not run-to-run or device-to-device variation

above_peak.note: This is consistent with cuDNN selecting Winograd or FFT algorithms; the algorithms were not identified by measurement

reduction.definition: median model-equivalent rate (a+2)V/t of the fused sum, V >= 16 MiB

superseded_notebook_split.status: superseded: calibration and validation share kernel signatures

cross_check_string_typed_signatures.note: reviewer's illustrative split (signatures compared as CSV strings); implementation cross-check only
